basic_info.description: 2-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850; 4 = $149,850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, March 14, 2025, 5pm. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on April 4th, 2025 at 5:00 PM. March 20 5-7pm, March 22&23 1-4pm. Fair Housing Opportunity.
